_doc: Every side street, driveway and junction-arm mouth along the Phase 3 legs (scripts/p3x_legs.py on the fresh OSM), one record per branch leaving either carriageway; station_cw_m on the clockwise leg, side L / R of the clockwise direction, leaves_toward / bearing_deg over the branch's first 15 m, flow in / out for one-way branches; z_node_m and the grades = 3DEP along the branch's own way (scripts/p3x_3dep.py, p3x_profiles.py). treatment_by_plan = EXPANSION-PHASE3-PLAN A1 / A2 applied to the OSM class: this is NOT tools/stub_roads.py's declaration (the PC runs `declare`).
